description.value: Freshbowl is a Southeast Asian fast-casual restaurant in Yaletown serving Malaysian-inspired salad, rice, and noodle bowls made from scratch with locally sourced, antibiotic-free, and hormone-free ingredients. The concept traces its roots to a Melakan family culinary tradition spanning generations, brought to Vancouver and adapted with a focus on fresh and organic produce. Outdoor seating is available, and online ordering for pick-up or delivery makes it a straightforward refuelling stop for cyclists in the Pacific Boulevard corridor.

bike_parking_detail: 1 rack within 100m: stands (7 spaces) at 66m. Total: 7 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms takeout/pick-up and delivery services, and the menu page explicitly labels vegan (V) and vegetarian (VG) options and notes gluten-free options are available on request, corroborating OSM's diet:vegan=yes and diet:vegetarian=yes tags. The phone number (604) 688-8565 and address 1128 Pacific Blvd on the website match OSM. No mention of bike parking, bike racks, water refill, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or device charging appears anywhere in the website content or OSM tags, so those fields remain null.
concerns: Minor postal code discrepancy in website: contact/locations page shows V6Z 2X7 while footer on all other pages shows V6Z 2X9. Likely a typo; V6Z 2X9 used as it appears consistently.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Freshbowl is an active, well-established fast-casual restaurant on Pacific Boulevard in Yaletown with confirmed takeout service, extensive vegan/vegetarian options, and outdoor seating — a practical and cyclist-friendly food stop near the seawall.
